name: 96793 · Wailuku, HI
findings: ZIP 96793 (Wailuku) has 159 nonprofit organizations. 67 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 96793 (Wailuku) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 96793 (Wailuku) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
